Workspace records are keyed by workspace id: migration 028 flips the `workspace_records` primary key to `(user_id, agent_id)` (one row per workspace; `host_id` becomes the mutable current-machine column, tombstone duplicates are collapsed with the active row always kept over a tombstone), adds `backup_bucket`, and new `PUT/DELETE /sync/records/by-workspace/{workspace_id}` routes land beside the host-keyed compat shims. `backup_bucket` is stored and consumed server-side (the retention reaper prefers it; name derivation stays as the legacy fallback) but is kept off the wire until the pre-tolerant strict client fleet leaves the support window.

Shares become workspace-keyed: migration 029 adds `workspace_id`/`share_label`; creates from workspace-aware clients mint a persisted random 32-hex share label and a hashed user segment, so CT-logged share domains publicize no internal id (host id, agent id, or SuperTokens user id). Re-shares keep the stored domain; legacy rows are grandfathered and backfilled. A supplied `workspace_id` must be `agent-<hex>` shaped (422 otherwise).

Workspace LLM key mints accept `workspace_id`, alias keys `workspace-<workspace_id>`, and rotate away legacy host-aliased keys. The `agent-` bucket short-name prefix is reserved for workspace backups alongside `host-`.
